title: Harden Network Workers WebView lifecycle safety
summary: Harden Network Workers UI lifecycle gating, setup confirmation, route metadata usage, worker state trust, and settings handoff clarity.
reason: Network Workers controls must clearly distinguish read-only evidence, dry-run checks, setup config writes, staged settings, and confirmed backend-owned lifecycle commands before operators use distributed mode.
behavior_before: The Network Workers page exposed backend-owned routes but could make confirmed lifecycle, setup write, route summary, and worker-state evidence appear more ready or direct than the backend contract intended.
behavior_after: Network Workers requires matching dry-run evidence before confirmed lifecycle actions, confirms setup write/secret commands, uses contract route paths, separates setup/lifecycle route posture, and renders worker state with clearer trust boundaries.
rollback_plan: Revert the Network WebView, Network settings builder, CSS, targeted WebView tests, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: Implementation must not add frontend ownership of lifecycle, queue claims, done reports, settings persistence outside backend routes, publish, rename, or media/source mutation. Browser validation must use temporary Local API fixtures only.
